why: pipeline, tracker ticket 1078, tests: In next/, S1 reader and pure editor test authoring is finished. Fourteen behavioral laws are written in six suites. Execution proof is pending CI under the owner instruction. This row records no red or green result.
note: L1 runs 500 cases. L2, L4, L6 to L11, L13 and L15 run 300 each at both depths. L5 uses 100, the current default count. L12 keeps the default property count and tea arbMsgSequence. L8 to L11 keep fc.commands with case-local legal coverage. L14 checks every code point against the installed Ghostty wasm, plus hard cell-position vectors. L24 remains the build-owned exhaustive role-map type check; L25 remains the existing package-imports lint. No product code, S2, settings or CI machinery changed. No tests, test listing, compiler, lint, fault, plant or benchmark was executed locally. Formatting, approved plan digest and owner/S1 comparisons, whitespace checks and source leak checks passed. Commits are unsigned and unpushed. CI must establish semantic red, green, and caught faults after build; an import failure is not semantic red. The lead approved the missing tests/S1 boundary registration in its own plan amendment. A separate tests commit adds only the fabsh libraries row using the existing next-program type. Existing layer and product import globs needed no edits.
